楚凝第二天天刚亮就带着几个缥缈宗的弟子到叶清秋门外，估计是想抓奸，谁知道开门是自家哥哥。

“哥……你……”楚凝指了指里面，又指了指楚夜，“你怎么会在这里？”

哥哥怎么会在这里？

她叫的那些人呢？

哥哥岂不是和……

楚凝心底一阵恐慌，抓着楚夜的手，“哥，你告诉我，你只是早上过来的对不对？”

楚夜耳根子发红，一想到昨晚的事，他就心荡神迷，那种美好的滋味，永生难忘。而且，那还是他一直喜欢的女子。

跟着楚凝来的几个弟子哪里还看不出是什么情况，楚夜喜欢叶清秋也不是一天两天的事，大家都心知肚明，只是以前叶清秋对楚夜都很平淡，没什么特别之处，怎么今天就睡到一块了？

“凝儿，这么早有什么事吗？”楚夜尽量让自己平静下来。

楚凝一看楚夜那样子，就知道昨晚和叶清秋在一起的肯定是他，顿时气得眼眶发红，死命的咬着下唇，也不知哪儿来的勇气，推开楚夜就往里面冲。

“叶清秋，你个不要脸的女人，勾引我哥哥。”楚凝蛮横的冲进房间，带着哭腔叫骂，“真以为你当了宗主就不得了，你有什么好得意的，不要脸，也不知道使了什么手段才当上这个宗主的。”

叶清秋已经穿好衣服了，本就阴沉的脸随着楚凝进来越发的阴沉，“滚出去！”

“叶清秋你个不要的女人，我今天就杀了你。”楚凝如同被激怒的狮子，抽出随身的佩剑就要冲上去，那架势，好像恨不得把叶清秋五马分尸。

叶清秋眼中杀意肆虐，抬手一挥，楚凝就被无形的力量掀飞，砸在房间的墙角。

“出去。”叶清秋冷眼扫向跟进来的几个弟子，那几人瑟缩一下，快速的退出房间，还顺手将房门关上了。

“妖女……”最先出来的弟子看到站在台阶上的人，下意识的喊了一声。

“这么早，干什么呢？”时笙好奇的往他们后面瞧。

“关你什么事！”其中一个弟子梗着脖子吼。

“好奇嘛。”时笙无所谓的笑了笑，那笑容里却满是恶意，“是不是你们宗主被人睡了？”

“你……”

要睡也是他们宗主睡别人，怎么会是宗主被睡了，真是狗嘴里吐不出象牙！

Chu Ning took several Piaomiao Sect disciples to Ye Qingqiu's door at dawn the next day, presumably to catch him, but who knew it was his brother who opened the door.

"Brother...you..." Chu Ning pointed inside and then at Chu Ye, "Why are you here?"

Why is my brother here?

What about those people she called?

Isn’t my brother and...

Chu Ning felt panic in her heart and grabbed Chu Ye's hand, "Brother, tell me, you just came here in the morning, right?"

Chu Ye's ears turned red, and when he thought about what happened last night, he was in a state of ecstasy. That wonderful feeling was something he would never forget.Moreover, that was the woman he had always liked.

The few disciples who came with Chu Ning couldn't tell what was going on. Chu Ye's liking for Ye Qingqiu didn't happen in a day or two. Everyone knew it, but Ye Qingqiu was very indifferent to Chu Ye in the past, and there was nothing special about him. Why did they sleep together today?

"Ning'er, what's wrong so early?" Chu Ye tried his best to calm down.

As soon as Chu Ning saw Chu Ye's appearance, she knew it must be him who was with Ye Qingqiu last night. She was so angry that her eyes turned red and she bit her lower lip desperately. She didn't know where she got the courage to push Chu Ye away and rushed inside.

"Ye Qingqiu, you shameless woman seduced my brother." Chu Ning rushed into the room arrogantly, crying and scolding, "I really thought that you would be great if you became the sect leader. What are you so proud of? You are shameless. I don't know what tricks you used to become the sect leader."

Ye Qingqiu had already put on his clothes, and his already gloomy face became even gloomier as Chu Ning came in, "Get out!"

"Ye Qingqiu, you are an unwanted woman, I will kill you today." Chu Ning was like an enraged lion, drawing out her sword and rushing forward. Her posture seemed like she wanted to tear Ye Qingqiu into pieces.

Ye Qingqiu's eyes were filled with murderous intent. With a wave of his hand, Chu Ning was lifted away by the invisible force and smashed into the corner of the room.

"Get out." Ye Qingqiu glanced coldly at the few disciples who followed him. Those few people flinched, quickly exited the room, and closed the door smoothly.

"Monster..." The disciple who came out first saw the person standing on the steps and shouted subconsciously.

"What are you doing so early?" Shi Sheng looked behind them curiously.

"None of your business!" one of the disciples yelled, holding his neck.

"I'm just curious." Shi Sheng smiled nonchalantly, but the smile was full of malice, "Did someone sleep with your sect leader?"

"You..."

If they want to sleep, their sect leader is sleeping with someone else. How could it be that the sect leader is sleeping with someone else? It’s really hard for a dog to spit out ivory!
